additional_info.subject: ID0478687-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PN 312562229/29] Connection Interruption CRM:03431000073
additional_info.body:
Dear Chetouah,
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we indeed see that the OCPP connection goes offline multiple times. Please note that OCPP communication issues are almost always related to network problems such as the network cable, SIM card, or the ping/pong network response.
The OCPP connection can go offline, because of an unstable network connection with the network provider, or because the router had trouble finding a signal.
Right now we see that the OCPP connection is stable and no errors are showing.
We will keep an eye on the charger for the next three days, to see if the problem occurs again.
If the problem occurs again, we will perform an on-site check to resolve the issue.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
